_sources.discrepancies: [2026-06-10] State primary Sept 8, 2026 and general Nov 3, 2026 confirmed (FVAP 2026 primary calendar; sos.nh.gov). NH has no online voter registration and no early voting; same-day registration is available at the polls on Election Day. Pre-election registration deadlines vary by town (6-13 days before the election, set by local supervisors of the checklist) - the by-mail/pre-registration dates in this file use a conservative estimate; voters should confirm with their town/city clerk. Added per-election registration and earlyVoting blocks that were previously missing.

earlyVoting.notes: New Hampshire does not offer early voting. Absentee ballots are available for voters who will be absent on Election Day, have a disability, observe a religious holiday, or cannot vote in person due to employment. Pre-election registration deadlines are set locally (6-13 days before the election, varies by town); you can also register at the polls on Election Day. Confirm with your town or city clerk: https://www.sos.nh.gov/elections/register-vote/registration-deadlines

votingRules.phonesAtPollsDetail: New Hampshire law does not have a statewide ban on phones at polling places. Local moderators may set rules. Photographing your own ballot is generally permitted, but photographing other voters is not. Check with your local election office.
additionalRules: Undeclared (independent) voters may vote in either party's primary and re-register as undeclared afterward
Registered party voters may only vote in their party's primary

primaryParticipation.ruleExplanationEn: New Hampshire has a semi-open primary (RSA 659:14). Voters registered with a party vote in their party's primary. Voters registered as 'undeclared' may request either party's primary ballot on Election Day and then re-register as undeclared after voting.
primaryParticipation.ruleExplanationEs: New Hampshire tiene una primaria semi-abierta (RSA 659:14). Los votantes registrados en un partido votan en la primaria de su partido. Los votantes registrados como 'sin declarar' pueden solicitar la boleta de cualquier partido el día de la elección y luego volver a registrarse como sin declarar después de votar.
